name: claude-code-toolkit
description: Session modes and self-improvement loops for Claude Code, pulled from a daily-driver config.

plugins.name: challenger
plugins.description: A skeptical staff-engineer session mode that pushes back on your decisions AND the existing code — but only when warranted. Levels: lite, full, ultra.

plugins.name: apply-improvements
plugins.description: Capture-now/review-next self-improvement loop: a SessionEnd hook queues what happened, a skill later audits it and applies only the config edits you approve.
